note: Grandote Lodge & RV Park (formerly Elk Valley RV Park and Fly Shop) on Hwy 12 at ~7,300 ft, across the road from Grandote Peaks Golf Course; the riverside spot is kept open so everyone can look at the Cucharas River. Golf $10 off a round for guests. --Claude
summary: Elk Valley RV Park's domain no longer resolves and Google marks 'Elk Valley RV Park & Gift Shp' permanently closed; the same address (5535 CO-12, 60 m from the pin) now operates as Grandote Lodge & RV Park. Its own site: open year round (was Apr-Oct), 4 pull-throughs + about 20 back-ins 28-38 ft (max 45 -> 38), $60/night or $600/month plus electric, showers, booked by phone with a 50% deposit. Cleared directory-derived water/sewer; amperage not stated. Over the US$50 gate with no gateway within 40 km (Great Sand Dunes 51 km); the family has not stayed here.
flags: Name change: the park now trades as 'Grandote RV Park' / 'Grandote Lodge & RV Park' (https://grandotelodge.com/rv-park; Google Maps 'Grandote Lodge & RV Park', 5535 CO-12). The fly shop is gone. Suggested name: Grandote RV Park.
Dead website: http://www.elkvalleyrv.com/ does not resolve (NXDOMAIN). Operator's page: https://grandotelodge.com/rv-park.
Phone: the stored 719-742-5533 belongs to the closed Elk Valley listing. The operator's site gives 719-999-2008 (Google lists (719) 890-9131 for Grandote Lodge & RV Park).
PRICE GATE: 'Rates are $60 per night' (operator, 2026) is over US$50; gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Great Sand Dunes NP 51 km); the family has not stayed here.

Presence: operator website with a phone and a posted nightly rate, but no online booking engine and the Google listing for the new name shows it as a lodge with no review count in the panel; monthly stays are also offered ($600/month plus electric), though a nightly rate is posted, so it is not long-stay only.
